sources.role: 本文内容の根拠。HTMLのgit blob SHAをバイト列から計算して指定値との一致を確認。gitコマンドは不使用。
本文内容の根拠。2026年11月4日のB.ONE全10試合は01:58 JST時点で試合前。当日TOP3は全試合の公式記録確定後。本文に選手名はない。タイトルのベスト5と本文の当日TOP3を混同せず、画像は試合予定を主題にした。
本文に登場する埼玉の現役選手をランダム抽選する候補の確認専用。記事内容・成績・出場の根拠には使用しない。
古牧昌也の本人確認・容姿参照専用。公式プロフィール写真をダウンロードして実際に目視。写真の貼付け、ロゴ、スポンサー、背番号は使用しない。
クラブ公式プロフィールのimg srcから取得。顔・髪型の目視参照および唯一の修正時の本人参照画像。
同一人物・2026-27埼玉所属の照合専用。外部の成績値を画像に持ち込まない。
view_imageで確認。黒#151A18・ライム#CCF43B、太い見出し、インク・ブラシ表現のみ参照。参照元の人物・名前・数値・試合結果は転用しない。
画像生成・検品ルール。人物を絞れない場合の主役、注記、readyの扱いは本依頼の最新指定を優先。

brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 pixels or larger.
Use the previously viewed approved black-and-lime thumbnail only as visual style guidance: deep almost-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory, forceful Japanese headline, hand-drawn ink hatching and rough dry-brush streaks, few elements. Do NOT copy any of its player identity, words, numbers or scores.
Subject: the REAL player Masaya Komaki / 古牧昌也, selected randomly from a team mentioned in the supplied article. Use the viewed official Saitama Broncos profile photograph as his likeness reference only. Adult Japanese man, athletic lean-muscular build, straight black hair with a center part and ear-length curtain fringe, open forehead, long oval face, defined jaw and chin, straight thick eyebrows, narrow almond eyes, straight medium nose, slightly full lips, no moustache or beard. Preserve these visible features. Do not invent a generic player. Do not paste any photo into the result.
Illustration: dynamic three-quarter low driving pose on the RIGHT 44% of the canvas; torso leaning into the drive, head facing slightly left and eyes looking upcourt, hair moving slightly, one hand naturally controlling one orange basketball at waist level while the other arm extends for balance. Anatomically credible hands, fingers and arms. Depict only this one player. Face, hair, hands and ball fully visible. Use strongly hand-inked black/ivory illustration with limited warm skin accents, no photorealistic rendering. Plain unbranded ivory basketball jersey and shorts with black trim; NO letters, names, numbers, badges, team logos, league logos or sponsor marks on clothing or ball. This is a conceptual basketball illustration, NOT a reconstruction of any actual game action or a prediction of participation.
Layout: LEFT 54% large bold typography, RIGHT 44% player with energetic sweeping lime brush arc behind him. Dark quiet text area. Generous 6% safe margins on all text. All required text must be cleanly separated from player and readable at thumbnail size. Oversized date and headline, smaller qualifiers and footer. Avoid scoreboards, statistics, medals, crowds and other people.
Render ONLY the following exact text:
small upper-left masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
large lime date: 「11/04」
largest ivory main headline on one line: 「試合予定」
small lime category tag: 「B.ONE」
clear supporting line below main headline: 「当日TOP3は公式記録確定後」
small but legible time qualifier: 「2026年11月4日 01:58 JST時点」
footer, clearly legible ivory on dark: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」
The article snapshot has all fixtures pregame and no finalized TOP3. Never imply a completed result. Do NOT put the player's name, his appearance, performance or any statistics in the image. Do NOT write best five, points or scores. Keep the exact AI disclosure and image disclaimer. One image only.

SINGLE CORRECTION
Edit reference image 1 (the existing black/lime Japanese basketball thumbnail) ONCE. Reference image 2 is the OFFICIAL identity reference of the real player Masaya Komaki / 古牧昌也 and must be used to correct the face and hair ONLY. Keep image 1's composition, body pose, hands, orange ball, clothing, black/lime/ivory palette, all Japanese text and numbers EXACTLY unchanged.
Critical identity correction: Image 1 currently incorrectly suggests a moustache and chin stubble, and the hair is too wavy/shaggy. Masaya Komaki in reference image 2 is clean-shaven with NO facial hair. Remove all moustache, goatee, beard and stubble indications. Render smooth clean skin around the upper lip, chin and jaw, with sparse directional ink shading that does not read as hair. Closely match reference 2's straight center-parted black curtain hair, neat sides near the ears, open forehead, oval moderately long face, jaw/chin contour, slightly narrow almond eyes, straight eyebrows, straight nose and closed to slightly parted lips. Retain the dynamic three-quarter upcourt gaze while making the face recognizably the photographed real player.
Keep the final artwork as visibly hand-drawn ink editorial illustration, NOT a photograph, do not paste the photograph. Do not copy any uniform logos, sponsor lettering, numbers or badge from reference 2. The jersey remains plain ivory with black trim. No additional people.
Preserve EXACT visible text:
バスケまとめ
11/04
試合予定
B.ONE
当日TOP3は公式記録確定後
2026年11月4日 01:58 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ
Do not add the player's name or any achievement, participation claim or score. Maintain landscape approximately 16:9 and at least 1536 pixels wide. Return exactly one corrected image.
